invariants.rationale: The method always constructs a new HoodieWriteMetadata and returns it, so result should never be null.
The setWriteStatuses method is called before returning, so the write statuses field should not be null.
clusteringPlan is dereferenced via getInputGroups(), so it must not be null for any normal execution completing the method.
schema is passed as a parameter and not modified in the method, and dereferencing it outside would be unsafe if it were null.
instantTime is used in downstream method calls and must be non-null for method execution to succeed.
